findings: The functional catalog exists, but its public state, styling, accessibility, package, and verification rules are inconsistent across control families.
Complex controls duplicate focus, dismissal, collection, and positioning responsibilities that mature headless libraries already maintain.
The default skin has implicit and consumer-wide CSS effects and does not provide complete recipes for the overlay and navigation family.
The repository does not yet expose a release package or one canonical product gate set.

reviews.subject: Initial quality-foundation draft
reviews.scope: Owner requirements against the active architecture and status documents.

filtered_passages: Prior review report and history excluded.
original_decision_evidence: Owner requirements supplied directly in the review packet.

missing_evidence: The response mapped requirements but did not return the required complete journey trace.

findings.subject: Quality ambition
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: Exceptional polish and ease of use were not explicit acceptance dimensions.
findings.impact: Technical conformance could be mistaken for the requested product quality.
findings.minimum_correction: State and evaluate polish and first-use usability.

findings.subject: GitHub documentation authority
findings.impact: A local draft could be mistaken for durable authority.
findings.minimum_correction: Record GitHub as the publication authority.

findings.subject: Premature approval label
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: The design link said approved while architecture remained in review.

reviews.conclusion: Useful fidelity findings were returned and corrected, but the missing journey trace prevents this attempt from establishing completed review coverage.
reviews.invalidated_by: The reviewed working-tree snapshot changed after the findings.

reviews.subject: Initial quality-foundation draft
reviews.scope: Implementation readiness of the active architecture and milestone documents.
not_assessed: Live build, browser, packed-consumer, hydration, and assistive-technology operation.
missing_evidence: The reviewer encountered prohibited prior inspection findings, so the attempt is not eligible as a fresh independent pass.

findings.subject: Per-control public contract
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: No canonical Core v1 control and part contract matrix exists.
findings.minimum_correction: Define every export, semantic element, prop boundary, state form, reset, callback, refusal, ref, and migration disposition.

findings.subject: Headless foundation boundary
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: The candidate and responsibility split are not selected.
findings.impact: Portal, focus, dismissal, layer, and positioning behavior remains ambiguous.
findings.minimum_correction: Select the dependency and define the responsibility and proof boundaries.

findings.subject: Token and skin schema
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: The schema, part inventory, recipes, scope, portal propagation, and approval artifact are not defined.
findings.minimum_correction: Create the reviewed skin contract and recipe matrix.

findings.subject: Package and gate contract
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: Artifacts, exports, dependency placement, environments, commands, and evidence are not exact.
findings.impact: Package and CI packets are not bounded.

findings.subject: Advancement sequence
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: Architecture approval, proof, disposition, gates, and packet eligibility are not sequenced precisely.
findings.minimum_correction: Define proof lifecycle and packet eligibility after foundation selection.

reviews.conclusion: The findings define the remaining architecture workload, but prohibited-input exposure prevents this attempt from satisfying independent completeness review.
reviews.invalidated_by: The reviewed working-tree snapshot changed after the findings.

reviews.subject: Initial quality-foundation draft
reviews.scope: Authority, milestone identity, lifecycle, links, and machine-readable alignment.

filtered_passages: Prior review report and history excluded.

missing_evidence: The response returned a consistency matrix but not the required complete journey trace.

findings.subject: Stable milestone identities
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: Existing machine IDs were reassigned to different GitHub issues and tasks.
findings.impact: Existing task identities would be associated with the wrong milestone.
findings.minimum_correction: Keep existing IDs and use a new ID for the inserted stage.

findings.subject: Workshop lifecycle truth
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: Revision, pending files, current action, approval, and license authority were stale or contradictory.
findings.impact: A later session would resume from false state.
findings.minimum_correction: Replace state with the current base, complete draft set, exact next action, and owner-only license authority.

findings.subject: Single active milestone
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: Both quality foundation and paused overlay work were marked in progress.
findings.impact: Machine state contradicted the pause and process.
findings.minimum_correction: Mark overlay work paused while quality architecture is active.

findings.subject: Superseded overview choice
findings.missing_or_contradictory_information: The overview said retain versus replace remained open after rebase had been decided.
findings.impact: Readers could infer an already closed option remained open.
findings.minimum_correction: State that only foundation selection remains open.

reviews.conclusion: Material consistency findings were corrected, but the missing journey trace prevents this attempt from establishing completed review coverage.
reviews.invalidated_by: The reviewed working-tree snapshot changed after the findings.
